༄༅/ /mol gtam yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ /swasti/bla ma dam pa sa lo chen po kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs chen gya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mol gtam yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// swasti/ bla ma dam pa sa lo chen po kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs chen gyi dbus su mol gtam bya tshul cung zad brjod na/ gang zhig la la gus pas brten cing skyabs su song na/ ngan 'gro dang srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag las skyob cing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lhar bcas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi 'dren pa dam par bzhugs pa lags/ /de dag gi rten yang spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams tshad med pa rnams na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs shing / bye brag tu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid na yang bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis reg pas mngon par mdzes pa byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje gdan dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gza' las thar ba ltar rdul dang bral bas dad pa'i 'jug ngogs dang ldan pa skye dgu ma lus pa'i sgron mer gyur pa shar phyogs ri bo rtse lnga dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba dri ma med pa dang / kunda'i phung po ltar thugs rje'i bsil byed kyis nye bar brgyan pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gnas ri bo po tā la dang / lha rdzas kyi nor bu nye bar 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i phung po ltar 'gro ba ma lus pa'i re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rin po che du ma'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa dpal gyi pho brang dang / sa'i cha glang po che'i spyi gtsug ltar mtho la gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas nye bar brgyan pa'i byang phyogs shambha la'i pho brang chen po dang / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro du ma 'du zhing / snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba'i re 'dod thams cad bde blag tu stsol ba nub phyogs u rgyan la sogs pa grub pa'i gnas khyad par can du ma na ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas khyad par du byas pa'i phul du byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs pa lags/

bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dam pa'i chos kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa'i bod kha ba can gyi ljongs/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ 'phags pa'i yul dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i sa phyogs mtha' dag na dkon mchog gsum gyi rten khyad par du 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i rdul dang mnyam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa lags/ khyad par du yon tan rmad du byung ba du ma dang ldan pas yid 'phrog pa'i cha byad can/ dad pa'i yid kyis bstod tshig rnam par g.yo ba'i dar dir gyis sgra sgrogs pa'i bung ba'i tshogs kyis kun nas dkris pa/ bsod nams dri ma med pa'i chu klung las byung ba'i snying po rnam par rgyas pa ltar rab tu dregs pa'i lha'i dbang po rnams kyi rgyun mi chad par btud pa'i 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang chen po dang tshul mtshungs pa/ gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po 'di nyid na yang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung yid bzhin nor bu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po de nyid kyi nang rten bkra shis sgo mangs/ gcen kun dga' 'bar nas/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa yan gyi 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gro mgon phyag na sogs kyi phyi rten/ nang rten/ de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son cing / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sngags 'chang mtshungs med rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi nang rten/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mi'i gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin pa sa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis phyag bzo dang /

rab tu gnas pa legs par mdzad pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba de nyid kyis byang shambha la la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi gnas chen khyad par can thams cad kyi byin rlabs rten dang / sa sna bsdus nas bzhengs pa'i rnal rgyal sku 'bum gyi nang na/ rgyal ba 'od srung gi ring bsrel pham gang la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi rten du ma bzhugs shing / deng sang gi bar du ring bsrel rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba dang / bla ma de nyid kyi thugs dam sgrol ma gsung 'byon g.yu mkhar mo/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma 'phral du ston par mdzad pa'i bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i rten bzhis gtso mdzad/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog thun mong gi dngos sgrub bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa rab mdzes lhun po'i drung na/ sna tshogs mdangs bkra mchod rdzas kyi ri bdun gyis nye bar bskor te/ bstan pa rin po che gces par bsrung ba'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong bsrung ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa lags// ༈ /skyabs gsum de dag gi phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo thub pa chen po'i rgyal tshab dam pa chos kyi mnga' bdag dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtso bo gangs can gyi khrod na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba/ 'di zhes …tshogs dpon su yin gyi mtshan brjod bya ba'i zhal snga nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'dren pa dam par bzhugs pa lags/ gzhan yang bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing mchog tu gyur pa/ tshul khrims kyi ge sar ngur smrig gi 'dab mas mdzes pa mdo sngags kyi cha 'dzin pa'i lung rigs kyi dbang phyug du mas brgyan pa/ 'phags pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / dad pa'i stobs kyis dkon mchog mchod cing /

snying rje'i stobs kyis 'khor 'bangs legs par skyong ba bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyi mngon par mtho ba'i mi che ba rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ dal 'byor gyi ljon shing / yon tan gyi 'bras bus lci bar gyur pa'i mkhyen pa can rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyan cing / dad gus kyi skyes bu dran shes bzhin gyi spyan ras gsal ba'i bya ba byed pa phyag bde ba dang bcas pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten/ 'di ltar tshogs pa rgya che zhing / dpal gyis brjid par bzhugs pa rnams kyang rnam par dkar ba'i smon lam bzang pos bskrun pa'i dal 'byor rin po che'i phreng ba/ chos dang dge legs kyi sbrel bas na 'brel pa zab/ dkar po dge ba'i las khyad par can la tshogs pas na tshogs pa yang bzang / lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na khams gsum gyi sems can dug gsum gyi nad kyis gzir ba rnams la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ mi mjed kyi zhing khams pa rnams la ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras shākya'i rgyal po de nyid bka' drin che ba lags// //'dzam bu gling pa'i 'gro ba pa rnams la ji snyed shes bya'i rab dbye gsal bar ston pa thogs med sku mched/ zab mo lta ba'i de nyid ston pa klu sgrub yab sras/ rnam dag rigs tshul ston pa phyogs glang chos grags te mkhas pa rgyun drug dang / bslab bya'i gnas 'gag ston pa slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong dang yon tan 'od ste mchog gnyis su grags pa rnams bka' drin che ba lags/ bod kha ba can gyi yul 'dir thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyi skyes bu yon tan bdun gyis nye bar mdzes pa dal 'byor gyi gru chen du zhugs nas/ 'phags yul rgya mtsho'i gling nas dam chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu blangs te/ phan bde'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas skye dgu rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/

sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lo paṇa skyes mchog khyad par can mkhas grub bzang rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che// //snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba phal mo che rnams la/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gangs can gyi khrod du sprul pa'i gzugs kyis rnam par dag pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa'i tshul bzung nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad phan bde la sbyor bar mdzad pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams bka' drin che ba lags/ sgos rang rang so so la lus sems bskyed pa'i pha dang ma/ thar lam ston pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon bzang rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ mchod yul du zhabs yangs par byon pa rnams sbyin pa'i bdag po phyag bde ba dang bcas pa la bka' drin che ba lags/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ rang re gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos 'gram btab/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos sde bstan pa dang bcas pa nyin mo ltar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i skabs su/ bdud sprul sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / bon nag re pa jo gur la sogs pas bar chad brtsams pa bzlog par mdzad pa'i phyir/ bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs bran du bkol ste drag po mngon spyod kyi las mdzad pas/ lo dang zla ba ma 'gyangs par bstan pa'i dgra bo gnyis ka tshar bcad de/ rnam smin gyi phung po yongs rdzogs/ gdan sa 'di nyid du 'byor te/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung dang sa'i gnad khyad par can du mnan pa la sogs pa'i las tshogs mthar phyin par mdzad pas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas te/ deng sang gi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phan yon phun sum tshogs shing / bkra shis dang dge legs dpag tu med pa 'di bzhin byung ba lags/ 'di lta bu'i phyag len mi nyams shing /

bstan pa spyi sgos kyi bstan dgra 'dul ba dang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi thog grangs/ bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sde dpon rigs/ dkar po dge ba'i las kyi 'brel ba 'jog pa'i sbyin bdag so so rnams kyi dus kyi rim gro la dmigs te/ lo ltar gyis bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod cing drag po'i las la bskul ba'i skabs 'dir/ rdo rje slob dpon/ sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa yi dam kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed maṇḍal mchod chog yi dam chos bsrung rnams la gtor 'bul/ bskang ba/ bstod pa sogs phyag len rnam par dag pa mdzad pa'i skabs su sbyin bdag rnams kyis/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa/ mkha' 'gro chos bsrung dam can rgya mtsho rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi mchod gtor/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la mang ja bsnyen bskur/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten/ gzhan yang gang la gang dgos kyi 'bul ba rnam gzhag dang bcas te/ dad gus kyi rdzing bu las 'khrungs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi me tog gi dngos po phul du byung ba 'di nyid/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa sku gsum gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku'i rim gro la'ang dmigs shing / khyad par gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa'i sku rim du/ bla brang nang nas phyag skyong mdzad nas bsgrub par gda' zhing / phyag bde ba rnams kyi bka' bzhin phyag len la thebs par bgyis te/ dge ba bsgrub pa ngo mtshar che zhing / rjes su yi rang ba lags/

slan chad kyang dge zhing bkra shis kyi dpal dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ gong nas lhag ma'i gtor ma/ rdo rje'i glu/ bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad sogs mjug gi cho ga rnams rim pa bzhin bkas gnang ba zhu lags// yang spyi sa nas bsgrub pa yin na/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa'i sku rim du/ gdan sa mdzod chen gyi bsgrub par gda' zhing sogs man gong bzhin byed/ sde srid nas yin na/ gzhis kha rin spungs nas sa skyong chen po mi'i dbang po ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug pa'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par gda' zhing / sa skyong chen po'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / chab srid mi nyams shing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyer kha so so nas phyag len la thebs par mdzad de/ dge ba bsgrub pa ngo mtshar che zhing / rjes su yi rang ba lags man gong bzhin/ de bzhin du shar rgyal mkhar rtse nas/ sa skyong chen po mi'i dbang po bsod nams lhun gyis grub pa'i bka' bzhin sogs/ g.yas ru byang nas sa skyong chen po mi'i dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi bka' bzhin sogs 'don pa bsgyur la bya/ yang gong gi mtshan rnams 'phos na mtshan gang yin de nas brjod pa rigs bsgre/ gzhan dpon rigs rnams la/ gdong dga' nas nang so'i sku rims su bsgrub par gda' zhing sogs man gong bzhin/ dpon rigs so so la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di ni gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos thog tu dgos pa'i mol gtam// //yang nged rang sa skya pa'i zhal ngo che 'don mdzad pa'i skabs su khri chen mo'i steng nas mol gtam byed dgos byung na/ bka' drin che tshul gong bzhin la/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal 'chi med kyi gdung las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i 'khon dpal po ches/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rje btsun rdo rje rnon po'i sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyi nang blon mdzad cing /

lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun gyi nang nas mkhyen rab kyi dbang po mchog tu yangs pa 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba dang / rigs sngags kyi nus pa mthar phyin pas log par 'dren pa'i dpung tshogs phyi mar mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje rin chen sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug 'khon ston rim par brgyud de/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de'i dbon sras gcen kun dga' 'bar la sogs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs bdun brgyud dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon po phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa mnyes pa'i bla ma dam pa du ma'i rigs kyi sras gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po go pe la dang / ta ming yun lo la sogs pa hor dang rgya'i rgyal rabs du mas gtso mdzad/ skye dgu mang po smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing / bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal la 'dren par mdzad pa mu tig gi phreng ba ltar spel legs su byon pa lags/ de rnams kyi rigs kyi thig le las bsam bzhin du 'gro ba'i don du sku skye ba bzhes pa chos kyi rje sogs che 'don gang mdzad pa'i yab kyi mtshan nas brjod la/ de nyid kyi lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa ches cher ngo mtshar du mas snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnam par grol ba'i lam du 'jug par mdzad pa lags/ de rnams thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu spungs pa'i bsod nams kyi lhun po tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i bang rim kun nas mdzes shing / mkhyen rabs dang thugs rjes phyogs kyi mu 'khyud rab tu gsal bar mdzad pa'i phrin las rta bdun can dang / ri bong 'dzin pa'i 'od zer rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi mtha' klas pa'i dpal kun tu bzang po'i ring lugs kha ba'i ljongs su ches cher rgyas pa'i phrin las kyi mnga' bdag

chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs che 'don mdzad mkhan gyi mtshan nas brjod pa'i rjes su/ 'di nyid bstan pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa'i skabs 'dir/ dal 'byor gyi gru chen rin po che thob pa'i dus su/ bshes gnyen dad pa'i ded dpon la brten nas/ rnam grol yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che blang dgos so/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung las 'byung zhing / de nyid thugs la bzhag nas gsung rab rgya mtsho bslab pa'i lhun po/ legs bshad 'od stong 'phro ba'i nyin byed/ smra ngag mun pa sel ba'i zla ba/ blo gros dbang po rgyas pa'i bdud rtsi/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i zhal gyi lung / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos/ legs par phye ba'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lam bzang zhes yongs su grags pa'i gzhung lugs kyi tshig don legs par phye ste gsung ba rnams/ da lo legs par gsung ba 'di bzhin lags/ de dag gi skabs su sngon dam pa'i chos kyi che ba dbyung ba'am/ gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol bzang po mi nyams par mdzad pa'i phyir/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la mang ja/ bsnyen bskur/ 'bul 'gyed kyi rnam gzhag bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas te/ dad gus kyi rdzing bu las 'khrungs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi me tog gi dngos po phul du byung ba skabs gsum dbang po'i dpal 'byor zil gyi gnon par mdzad pa'i bkra shis dga' ston rgya chen po bsgrub par gnang ba 'di nyid/ spyir gyis phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs nas/ sku'i rim gro la'ang dmigs shing / zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir du bstan pa'i rnam gzhag la dmigs nas gnang bar gda' zhing / phyag bde ba rnams kyi bka' bzhin phyag len la thebs par bgyis te/ dge ba bsgrub pa ngo mtshar che zhing /

rjes su yi rang ba lags/ slan chad kyang dge zhing bkra shis kyi dpal dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ gong nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa'i bsngo ba dang / smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu lags/ 'di nged rang dus mchod pa dang / lha khang bla brang pa'i zhal ngo che 'don gyi mol gtam// ༈ /yang bla brang shar pa che 'don skabs dgos pa byung na/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid gangs can gyi khrod du gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la mi'i gzugs su nye bar bstan nas/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i dpal gyis mtha' yas pa'i skye dgu'i tshogs rnams phan bde la 'god par mdzad pa ni/ dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhabs de nyid lags/ de'i sku zhang gi rigs su 'khrungs shing zhi ba dang / dul ba'i yon tan gyis 'byor pa/ bzo dang / gso ba'i gnas la mkhas pa/ khyad par du yang rgya nag po'i rim pa las 'ong ba'i rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la thugs shin tu byang bar gyur pa ni/ bla ma chen po jo 'bum zhes grags so/ /de'i sras lcam sring lnga byung ba'i mchog tu gyur pa ni/ gcen bla ma shar pa chen po shes rab 'byung gnas kyi/ chos kyi rgyal po rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul gus pa'i sgo nas blangs te/ mdo rgyud man ngag mtha' dag la rab kyi mthar son pa/ rje btsun sa skya paṇḍi ta'i sras kyi thu bor gyur pa zhig go /de'i gcung rdo rje 'od zer nas rigs kyi sras gcig tu brgyud pa/ shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rgya nag gi rgyal po'i lung gis ti shri'i mtshan gsol ba shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen la sogs pa mkhas grub du ma byung zhing / khyad par ces pa'i rjes la che 'don mdzad pa po'i yab kyi mtshan nas brjod/

de'i rgyal tshab dam par che 'don mdzad mkhan gyi mtshan nas brjod pa'i rjes su 'di nyid bstan pa'i rnam gzhag sogs bkod bzhag mdzad pa'i dga' ston du/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa sogs man gong bzhin/ yang dgongs rdzogs dang thun mong du bkod bzhag gnang ba shar na/ yab lta bu gshegs pa'i mtshan nas brjod/ zhing khams 'di'i gdul bya re zhig rdzogs nas/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i dam pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / de'i rgyal tshab tu 'di zhes bya ba bkod gzhag gnang ba'i dga' ston thun mong du sogs rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /bla brang shar pa'i 'di dang / sde srid chen po'i dro 'gyad kyi dus khri chung byang ma'i steng nas mol gtam byed/ sde srid chen po rnams kyi dus kyi dgos pa skabs don kyang gong bzhin de dang de'i gdung rabs shes shing byed par spro na byed/ mi shes na sa skyong chen po 'di zhes bya ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir/ sde srid 'di 'dra zhig nas bsgrub par gda' zhing sogs rigs 'gre/ gang zag phal pa'i dro bar lta bu la khri chung lho ma'i steng nas gtong ba'i dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na sbyin pa'i bdag po 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyi tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du bla ma dang dkon mchog spyan sngar mchod pa/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la mang ja/ bsnyen bskur/ 'bul ba/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas te bsgrub pa de nyid/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs dang / khyad par tshe 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i don du/ bsam sbyor dad gus dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par gda' zhing sogs man gong bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /cung zad tshig bsdus pa la dga' na gong gi sbrul shad nas sbrul shad kyi bar/ g.yung drung ris nas g.yu drung ris kyi bar/

mig bris pa nas/ mig bris pa'i bar rnams dor la nyams su blang ngo / /zhes pa'i mol gtam gyi rim pa 'di rnams/ sa lo chen po la sogs pa'i bla ma dam pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi gsung rtsom rnams la gzhi byas/ rang gi blo gros kyis kyang cung zad dpyad de sbyar ba 'di ni/ dbu mdzad dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan pa bkra shis kyi yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ chos med snyoms las mkhan sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis bzhi thog bla brang gi yang stengs su bris pa'o/ /yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dpal 'byor yin/ 'dis blo gsar rnams la phan thogs shing dge legs dang bkra shis 'phel bar gyur cig/ //dge zhing bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ mol gtam yid bzhin nor bu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
